memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'Go. I will be with you.'

sequence.prompt: How did God win with Gideon's tiny army? Put it in order.

items.label: An angel called Gideon a mighty warrior
Gideon said, 'But I am the least'
God sent most of the army home
The three hundred smashed their jars

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: He felt like the least important
So small that God got the credit

application.question: Gideon felt like the least important person. When do you feel small?

options.label: When I cannot do it yet

application.followUp: God never told Gideon he was stronger than he thought. He said something better: 'I will be with you.' Small is fine. God is strong.
